evidence.quote: A battery-powered occupancy sensor comprising a passive infrared detector and a high-power sensing element, wherein the passive infrared detector wakes the high-power sensing element for a fixed observation window upon detecting motion, and the high-power sensing element is switched off if no occupant is classified within the window.
A passive infrared detector wakes the high-power element for a fixed observation window when motion is detected, and the element is switched off again if no occupant is classified within the window.

A battery-powered occupancy sensor comprising a passive infrared detector and a high-power sensing element, wherein the passive infrared detector wakes the high-power sensing element for a fixed observation window upon detecting motion, and the high-power sensing element is switched off if no occupant is classified within the window.
A passive infrared detector wakes the high-power element for a fixed observation window when motion is detected, and the element is switched off again if no occupant is classified within the window.
A battery-powered occupancy sensor configured to transmit a message only when an occupant count changes, and to transmit a heartbeat message at a fixed interval when the count has not changed.
